# RaggieScript (v1.2.0) — Documentation & API Index

> Complete language, gradual type system, 21-namespace Standard Library (incl. 23-method zero-dependency archive.* suite), Declarative Win32 Wizard UI, Two-Way .NET Host SDK (RaggieScript.Core), RSWBC2 bytecode, and RSW700-RSW715 diagnostic reference for RaggieScript (.rssc).
> Compiled by RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.6.0 (MIT Code / CC BY-SA 4.0 Docs)

## Full Machine-Readable Corpus
- [Complete Concatenated Reference (llms-full.txt)](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/llms-full.txt)
- [Master A-Z API & Symbol Index](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/api-index)

## Chapters & Reference Topics
- [Welcome & 60-Second Quick Start](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/): Overview of RaggieScript v1.0 (.rssc), gradual static typing, RSW701/RSW702 safety, and 21-namespace standard library map.
- [CLI (raggiescript.exe), LSP, VS Code & SDKs](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/cli-and-sdk): Reference for check, compile, disasm, run, fmt, lsp, transpile-es2022, pack-exe, init, KEY:VAL locks, C++20 SDK, and .NET RaggieScript.Core.
- [Lexical Grammar, Preprocessor & Expressions](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/syntax-and-preprocessor): Preprocessor directives (#define, #ifdef, include), interpolated/raw/SemVer literals, path-join '/', '??' coalesce, and control-flow statements.
- [Gradual Type System, struct, enum, match & Closures](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/types-structs-enums): Static type annotations, type inference, struct records, string/int enums, match pattern matching, typed fn, and first-class '=>' closures.
- [Package Headers, param, feature, payload & Phases](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/headers-and-phases): Top-level package/showcase/app blocks, CLI params, features, RSWPAK1 payloads, wizard/install/repair/uninstall lifecycle, and Uac.Deferred.
- [Global Functions, Enum Constants, Validation & compile.*](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/builtins-and-constants): Global builtins (str, int, path, ver, len, assert, def), built-in enums (Scope, Uac, Hive, RegView, Token, WizardStyle), Validation.*, compile.*, payload.*, and feature.*.
- [sys.* — Silicon, OS Kernel, UAC, Folders & Reboot](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-sys): Complete reference for all 43 sys.* methods and 26 sys.* properties (IsWow64Process2 ARM64/x64, RtlGetVersion, UAC, High Contrast, Known Folders, RunOnce resume).
- [str.*, regex.*, array.*, json.*, ini.* & xml.*](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-data-and-text): UTF-8 string helpers, ECMAScript regex, functional array.map/filter closures, JSON parse/stringify, and rollback-journaled .ini & .xml surgery.
- [fs.* & reg.* — Transactional Filesystem & Registry](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-fs-and-reg): All 34 fs.* methods (SHA-256, Authenticode, PE fileVersion, RSWPAK1 extract, .rswbak rollback) and all 13 stateless 64/32-bit reg.* methods.
- [archive.*, crypto.*, net.* & log.*](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-archive-crypto-net-log): Zero-dependency 23-method archive.* engine (.zip, .7z/LZMA2, .rswpak LZMS, .cab, .tar.*, .zst, .iso ISO-9660, .wim wimgapi.dll), bcrypt.dll SHA-256 & UUIDv5, WinHTTP TLS 1.2/1.3, and setup logging.
- [proc.*, ffi.*, rm.*, shortcut.*, shell.*, env.*, arp.*, svc.*, task.*, firewall.* & acl.*](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-proc-ffi-rm-system): Token.Desktop Explorer de-elevated launch, 64-bit native DLL FFI, Restart Manager, shortcuts, file associations, non-clobbering PATH, ARP, Services, Firewall, and NTFS ACLs.
- [msi.* & prereq.* — 64-Bit MSI SQL, .MST & Runtimes](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-msi-and-prereq): All 21 msi.* calls (direct 64-bit SQL DDL/DML, SummaryInformation, Binary streams, .mst transforms, MsiSetExternalUIRecord) and 7 prereq.* .NET 8-11 / WebView2 / VC++ detectors.
- [ui.*, wizard.* & showcase.* — Declarative Win32 Wizard UI](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/ns-ui-and-wizard): All 14 declarative in-window Win32 wizard controls (two-way ref bindings, reactive when:, inline validate:), 9 modal TaskDialog/file pickers, 11 WizardStyles, and Showcase hotspots.
- [Studio Profiles (training.*, a11y.*, localization.*, document.*, launcher.*, help.*)](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/studio-sandbox-profiles): RSW702 capability-sandboxed APIs for SCORM 1.2/2004 ES2022 courses, WCAG 2.2 luminance contrast rules, XLIFF/WebVTT CPS gates, Tagged PDF/UA-1 fields, and F1 routing.
- [Diagnostics Reference (RSW700 – RSW715)](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/diagnostics-reference): Complete guide to RSW700 syntax, RSW701 phase isolation, RSW702 capability sandbox, RSW704 SHA-256 tamper gate, and RSW710-RSW715 static type diagnostics.
- [RSWBC2 Bytecode ISA & .rsw-rollback.jnl Spec](https://raggiescript.raggiesoft.dev/bytecode-and-rollback): Binary header specification for SHA-256 authenticated RSWBC2 linear stack bytecode, complete opcode table, and LIFO transactional rollback ledger architecture.
